lines.zh: 我低着头走，肩膀一耸一耸。
lines.en: I walk head down, shoulders rolling.
My boots snap twigs and I do not care.
I grind my teeth the whole way, counting.

lines.zh: 我斜着眼看路，也在看你。
lines.en: I watch the road sideways, and you too.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，力气全攒着。
lines.en: I walk slowly, saving all my strength.
I crash through a wooden door without stopping.

lines.zh: 我喘气时，胸口起伏得厉害。
lines.en: Every breath makes my chest heave hard.

lines.zh: 我顺着篱笆摸，找能撞的桩。
lines.en: I feel along the fence for a post to hit.
I trample the garden flat.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把脖子转了一圈。
lines.en: I stop and roll my neck once.
I am loud when I walk and cannot hide it.

lines.zh: 我朝村子那头走，越来越快。
lines.en: I head for the far village, faster each step.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛一直没移开。
lines.en: I stand still, eyes never leaving.
I flex my fists and knuckles pop.
I am counting the iron on you.
I wipe my nose on my sleeve.
I am deciding which side to hit first.
I stamp my foot and the ground numbs.

lines.zh: 我不说话，说话浪费时间。
lines.en: I do not talk; talking wastes time.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，又低头。
lines.en: I glance at the sky, then down again.
My shoulders shake from held-back force.

lines.zh: 我吐了口唾沫，吐得很远。
lines.en: I spit, and it flies far.
I fix on you and nothing else.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的眉毛就压下去。
lines.en: You move and my brow drops.

lines.zh: 我从头看到脚，又看回去。
lines.en: I look you up and down, then back.
I see the sword in your hand.
I squint as if measuring the distance.
We stare; I smile first.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的头就歪一下。
lines.en: You step back and my head tilts.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔张得很大，在闻你怕不怕。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, sniffing your fear.
Three breaths of staring is enough.

lines.zh: 眼睛别乱转，我盯得很紧。
lines.en: Keep your eyes still; I am locked on.
I bit my lip; now I am angrier.

lines.zh: 这刀砍在我肩上，卡住了。
lines.en: The blade is stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 退了半步，我脚跟钉回土里。
lines.en: Half a step back, then my heels dig in.

lines.zh: 血从鼻子里流下来，我抹了。
lines.en: Blood runs from my nose; I wipe it.
I grunt once and admit nothing.

lines.zh: 你打中我一回，不会有第二回。
lines.en: You landed one. There will not be a second.
My bracer split, still usable.
That blow reminds me of an old debt.
I bend over and take two breaths.
I glare at you harder than before.
Emeralds? I want them, but I will not trade.
You hold out bread like a shield.
I will not touch food you hand me.
That pouch of green hurts my eyes.
Put it down, then back off ten paces.
I can skip ramming you. Just once.

lines.zh: 你手抖了，我不喜欢抖的手。
lines.en: Your hand shakes; I dislike shaking hands.

lines.zh: 收好，别让我看见第二眼。
lines.en: Put it away before I look twice.
I take. I do not accept gifts.
Swallow that ration yourself.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，你退了三步。
lines.en: One shoulder and you are three steps back.

lines.zh: 你撞得自己后退，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You stagger back; I have not moved.
I did not yield; you did.
I brush you aside with one arm.
That one was without effort.

lines.zh: 你站稳了，算是有点本事。
lines.en: You kept your feet. That is something.
Do not crowd me; I dislike it.
I step forward, so you step back.
The fence you bent is on you.
Once more and I hit back.

lines.zh: 我的搭档还在营地等着。
lines.en: My partner waits back at camp.
We always break doors together.
She is faster; I am meaner.
We take left and right, never the same.

lines.zh: 我肩膀上有她缝的补丁。
lines.en: She stitched the patch on my shoulder.
When this village is done, I go to her.
We compete over who knocks farther.

lines.zh: 她笑起来，牙和我一样歪。
lines.en: Her teeth are as crooked as mine.
Apart too long, I get restless.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背，谁也进不来。
lines.en: Back to back, no one gets through.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂脚边那块石头。
lines.en: I heft a stone to judge its weight.
That sack on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我抓了把土，往你那边撒。
lines.en: I grab dirt and fling it your way.

lines.zh: 我捡起半块面包，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up half a loaf and sniff it.
This plank will serve as a shield.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I bend slowly, eyes still on you.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西都塞进怀里。
lines.en: Everything I find goes into my coat.
An iron nail; I bite down on it.
I pick up your arrow and snap it.
Done picking, I dust my hands.
I have watched you long enough.
I crouch and dig my heels in.
Standing there makes you a target.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，肩膀抬起来。
lines.en: I inhale and my shoulders rise.
You are the one I will hit.
I have cleared this road.
Do not try to circle; I am not slow.
My head drops; that is the signal.
Whoever runs first falls first.
I clamp my teeth shut.
No one is behind you; I checked.

lines.zh: 这一下，我攒了三天的火。
lines.en: I saved three days of anger for this.
I count down; at one I charge.
Do not stare; it will not help.

lines.zh: 我把肩头朝你，这就是开始。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder toward you. That is the start.
I run alongside you, heavy-footed.
You turn into an alley; I go through the wall.
I do not chase fast; I chase true.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你腰。
lines.en: My eyes stay on your waist.
You take the stairs; I wait below.
I pant loudly but never stop.
Look back and I speed up.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的门全撞开了。
lines.en: I break every door in my way.
The more you retreat, the surer I am.

lines.zh: 巷子尽头是死路，我早看过。
lines.en: The alley dead-ends; I checked already.
I am waiting for your foot to slip.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我鼻子记着。
lines.en: My nose remembers how you smell.
You run longer, but you will tire.
I knock things down as I come, openly.

lines.zh: 我一路把木板踩断给你听。
lines.en: I snap the planks loud enough for you.

lines.zh: 你别贴着墙，墙会帮你倒。
lines.en: Stay off the wall. It will help you fall.
When my nose sounds, I stop changing targets.

lines.zh: 我跑得不快，但我不用停。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never have to stop.
I ram headfirst and you fly.
My fist is heavier than a door bar.
That elbow lands on your ribs.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子，往地上按。
lines.en: I grab your collar and drive you down.
I need no weapon; my hands suffice.
After the hit I turn and hit again.
You blocked it, and your arm is shaking.
I strike with clenched teeth, silent.
I plant a boot on your shield and press.
I waited a long time for that one.
You are down and I am still charging.
My forehead leaves you dizzy.
Afterward I exhale, satisfied.
Get up; I am not finished.

lines.zh: 我拿肩膀当锤子，砸你胸口。
lines.en: I use my shoulder as a hammer on your chest.
I drive you flat against the wall.
I charge in from the camp side.

lines.zh: 灾厄的旗还没立，我先到了。
lines.en: The banner is not up yet; I arrived first.

lines.zh: 我落地时踩塌了半块砖。
lines.en: I land and crack half a brick.

lines.zh: 我第一眼就找最壮的那个。
lines.en: My first look goes to the biggest one.

lines.zh: 有人吹了声哨，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone whistled, and I came.
I come with a wooden post on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁和烟的味道。
lines.en: I smell iron and smoke.

lines.zh: 我吐掉嘴里的土，站起来。
lines.en: I spit out dirt and stand.
The village is smaller than I remember.
I roll my sleeves to the elbow.

lines.zh: 我先吼了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I roar once as a greeting.
I count the windows and start choosing.
Fire singed my brow, and it stinks.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的膝盖磕软了。
lines.en: I landed and my knee went soft.

lines.zh: 水深得过头，我喝了一口。
lines.en: The water ran deep and I swallowed some.

lines.zh: 这一炸，我听不见自己吼。
lines.en: After that blast I cannot hear my own roar.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我背上，很痒。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back and it itches.
This spell makes my legs weak.
I am hungry enough to chew the fence.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的头发全立了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 掉进黑里，我连墙都摸不到。
lines.en: Falling into black, I cannot even find a wall.
